name: Profile
title: Templates/Platform/Account/Profile
summary: The profile page of a signed-in account, and the layout every account settings page follows: a small page heading over seven stacked sections, each a flush `Card` of field rows, in the form column, with the unsaved-changes bar that rises once a saved field changes. Account name and Billing emails come filled from the account and are checked on Save; the Appearance font picker defaults to Rubik. A save that fails with no field to blame raises an error toast with Retry and keeps the changes. Other account pages (billing, credentials, users, teams) keep the same column and swap the sections for their own cards or tables. Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Tag`, `HelperText` and `Button`; its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.
